name: evidence-levels
description: The level a claim must reach before it may be published as fact, and before it may authorize a change.

E0.name: ASSERTED
E0.description: A statement with no artifact behind it

E1.name: DOCUMENTED
E1.description: Supported by a pinned vendor documentation snapshot

E2.name: STATIC
E2.description: Supported by source, AST or the build model

E3.name: ARTIFACT_VERIFIED
E3.description: The published artifact itself was inspected

E4.name: EXECUTED
E4.description: It compiled, or the tests actually ran

never: Omit an uncovered dimension from the coverage statement
Let an E0 or E1 claim authorize a mutation
Report a dimension as passed when it was not evaluated

manifest_verdicts.VERIFIED: Every referenced artifact is present and its hash matches
manifest_verdicts.ARCHIVED: Artifacts were pruned by retention; the manifest itself is intact
manifest_verdicts.TAMPERED: An artifact is present but its content no longer matches its recorded hash
